integrity: The stated edge limit is supported by a standalone analytic proof. Finite checks in check.py assess identities and normalization; they cannot certify an infinite limit.
scientific_limitations: Integer Erlang shape m≥2, positive fixed rates, deterministic orientation reversals and no translational Brownian noise. Coefficient is an exact negative moment of a renewal entrance-gap perpetuity, numerically estimated rather than evaluated in elementary closed form. No assertion of independent validation or worldwide publication priority.
title: A logarithmic edge hierarchy for Erlang-run active particles in a harmonic trap
